meta.name: conversation-archaeologist
meta.description: Mine ALL past Marq AI conversations to build a living 'User Manual About You'. Extract writing style, business context, goals, preferences, and patterns. Make all other skills smarter with context.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从历史对话中提炼你的个人使用手册
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望AI记住你的写作风格和业务背景
copy.tagline_en: Extract your personal user manual from past conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI to remember your writing style and business context

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析你过去与 Marq AI 的所有对话，提取你的写作风格、业务背景、目标、偏好和模式，生成一份活的“用户手册”，让其他技能更懂你。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 帮你处理某个任务（如“帮我写邮件”），或直接说“分析我的对话”时触发。

say.text: 分析我过去的所有对话，总结我的写作风格。
say.note: Claude 会生成一份关于你的风格报告。

say.text: 根据我的历史对话，帮我写一封专业的商务邮件。
say.note: Claude 会参考你的偏好来撰写。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes all your past conversations with Marq AI to extract your writing style, business context, goals, preferences, and patterns, creating a living 'User Manual About You' that makes other skills smarter with context.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to help with a task (e.g., 'Help me write an email') or directly say 'Analyze my conversations'.

say_en.text: Analyze all my past conversations and summarize my writing style.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a style report about you.

say_en.text: Based on my history, write a professional business email for me.
say_en.note: Claude will reference your preferences to compose it.
